## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0787433192c30b506f3c4b09c337bc5d59e0b0ce`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#6349 (body and all 24 comments, through the batch 6 claim `6080168957` and the dev report `6080839326`); PR objectui#12057 (body, the 15-file list, and the net diff against `main` at the head: merge base `3fd86251`, +134/−56); and the 43 check-runs on the head: 40 success, 3 skipped (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, the coverage-shard matrix placeholder), 0 failure. Every reading below beyond those is a `gh api` read of the head's tree; nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Each batch row converged by the card's rename branch ("where the two shapes really are different things, rename one"), and every public-surface change the diff implies was checked against the head's export maps and entries.

- **`Diagnostic` (three sites, three meanings sharing only `message`) — right.** `packages/sdui-parser/src/types.ts` keeps the name and is untouched. The flow site becomes `FlowSimDiagnostic`, and its two importers (`flow-problems.ts`, `flow-sim-validate.ts`) follow; the doctor site becomes `DoctorDiagnostic`, and its one test importer follows. Neither renamed site is publishable: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `exports` map has `.` and `./styles.css` only, and its `src/index.ts` (528 lines) has no `export *` and no export from `previews/simulator/*` or `flow-problems`; `@object-ui/cli`'s `exports` map has `.` only, and its `src/index.ts` exports exactly `serve` and `init`. No importable name moves. The PR's dependency sentence is also right: neither app-shell nor cli lists `@object-ui/sdui-parser`, and app-shell reaches plugin-designer as a peer only, so no re-point was dependency-legal that would not also have changed a consumer's shape.
- **`DiagnosticLevel` (two sites, two vocabularies) — right.** The flow designer's `'error' | 'warning'` keeps the name, since `flow-problems.ts` types structural, server and expression problems with it; the doctor's `'ok' | 'warn' | 'error'` becomes `DoctorDiagnosticLevel`. Unpublished on both sides (the same entries as above).
- **`ConfirmDialogState` (two sites, two meanings sharing only `message`) — right.** app-shell's (`ActionConfirmDialog.tsx`: `open`, `options`, the promise's `resolve`) keeps the name and is untouched. The designer's hook result becomes `DesignerConfirmDialogState`, following `DesignerHistoryState`, and `hooks/index.ts` re-exports the new name. `@object-ui/plugin-designer`'s `exports` map has `.` only, and `src/index.tsx` exports `useConfirmDialog` (line 50) but never `ConfirmDialogState`, with no `export *`: the old name was never importable, and `hooks/index.ts` is unreachable from outside the package. The only published change is the type name inside `useConfirmDialog`'s declaration; the members are unchanged.
- **Ledger — right.** `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` has 22 rows at the merge base and 19 at the head; the set difference is exactly `ConfirmDialogState`, `Diagnostic`, `DiagnosticLevel`, with no row added. The Filter rows, `FilterBuilderOperator` and `CalendarEvent` are present and untouched at the head, as the claim requires. The rewritten comment above the Filter rows is accurate: objectui#7561 and objectui#9306 read `closed`, PR objectui#10823 reads `merged` (`fb91ac9b0`), matching this card's record `5858391677`; and the gate's green at head with both rows present confirms the comment's own claim that the two names still carry two declarations each.
- **Riders — right, comment-only.** `AiChatPage.tsx` no longer calls `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` a deprecated alias nor tells new code to spell `ChatMessage`; `useObjectChat.ts` and `chatMessageAdapter.ts` name `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`. Consistent with batch 5's landing (`6080141964`: the plugin root has 0 export lines naming `ChatMessage`).
- **Accept-set — right.** The gate verdicts settle it: `Type Check`, `Test (shard 1/8)` through `(8/8)`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Lint`, `README Export Check`, `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `Bundle Analysis`, `Build & E2E` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all read success on the head. So no importer of a renamed name was left behind, and no new colliding name was introduced (the one-authority gate fails in both directions and ran in the shards).
- **Fences — held.** All 15 files sit on the claim's surface: the three site files, their importers, the test beside `doctor.ts`, the ledger, the three named riders and four changesets. Nothing under `packages/fields/**`, `plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, the app-shell index, `apps/console/src/services/**`, `cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`, `components/src/ui/**` or `packages/i18n/**`. The two surviving authorities (`packages/sdui-parser`, `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx`) are untouched.
- **PR shape — right.** Draft; first line `Refs #6349 (batch 6)`; no closing keyword anywhere in the body; `Clause-②: yes` at line start; one commit.

### ② Semver level

- The PR's `Clause-②: yes` line is right: a root-exported declaration of `@object-ui/plugin-designer` (`useConfirmDialog`'s return type) changes its named type, so the published declarations move even though no importable name does. A `no` would have under-declared.
- `.changeset/6349-batch6-plugin-designer.md` **`minor`** with a breaking-change note — right by the claim's own criterion (`6080168957`: `minor` where a published shape widens or a name moves). The note is accurate: the root never exported `ConfirmDialogState` (verified above), and the hook's result keeps the same members.
- `.changeset/6349-batch6-app-shell.md`, `6349-batch6-cli.md` and `6349-batch6-plugin-chatbot.md` **`patch`** — right: each package's built entry publishes neither the old nor the new name (verified above), and chatbot's change is comments only. A changeset is still owed, because `check-changeset-presence` counts changed source files of released packages.
- No `major` — right (objectui AGENTS.md §9; `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` all read success on the head).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions[0]` (changeset grade, A or B) — answered: A.** The claim grades per package, and three of the four packages move nothing on their published surface; B would grade a comment-only change `minor`. Not blocking: the fixed group's released version is the same either way. The seat ratifies A in its ACCEPT; no maintainer decision is needed.
- **Flow `DiagnosticLevel` kept, doctor's renamed — accepted** (reason in ①; the gate's green at head proves exactly one declaration remains).
- **JSDoc on the three renamed declarations, and two rider lines beyond the named ones — accepted**: comment-only, in claim files, in the same blocks the riders name.
- **Not run locally (full app-shell suite; type-checks of components, layout, plugin-dashboard, console and schema-catalog; `check:readme-exports`; the i18n and doc-snippet gates) — covered by the head's check-runs**: all eight `Test` shards, `Type Check`, `README Export Check` and `Doc Snippet Type Check` read success, and no locale pack or docs page is in the file list.
- **First ablation run refused and re-run — accepted**: the dev cites only the re-run, and the gate's CI verdict is the gate of record here, not the ablation.
- **Correction to batch 5's ACCEPT note (the stale `AiChatPage.tsx` sentence never shipped in built JS, since a type-only import specifier is elided) — escalated to the seat as a record-only correction**; nothing in this PR depends on it, and it was not re-measured here.
- **`hooks/index.ts` still an unreachable barrel; the flow `DiagnosticLevel` and sdui-parser's `Severity` share one vocabulary under two names — noted, not filed**, as the dev did; neither is a collision under the gate.
- Tier notice `5612085492` lifted this card's contract-review-tier requirement; the seat runs the review at the ceiling because of the `Clause-②: yes` line, as it did for batches 4 and 5. Nothing here needs a maintainer.
